Title: EnableAppUpload
Description: The app is the front door for submissions. Upload is collected by the app and written by EOM-05; the Attachments control is not used.

Title: EnableFolderDropIntake
Description: Folder drops keep working. EOM-02 watches the library and routes strays to Needs Classification.

Title: EnableUnmatchedQueue
Description: scrUnmatched. Turning this off hides the queue but does not stop EOM-02 writing to it.

Title: EnableEOYModule
Description: End of year closeout items. Same engine and same row shape as EOM; only the reporting period differs.

Title: EnableDiagnosticsScreen
Description: scrDiagnostics. Still additionally requires Developer_Flag on MF_Security_Mapping; the flag alone is not sufficient.

Title: EnableNotifications
Description: EOM-04 email notifications. Ships FALSE. Read the event log for a full cycle before enabling.

Title: EnablePowerBIEmbed
Description: Embedded COP tile on scrHome. Ships FALSE until the gov-region workspace is confirmed.

Title: EnableDocumentContentAI
Description: Tier 2 content-based classification. Ships FALSE and no code path exists in R1. The architecture declares facility document type and period at upload so inference is not needed.

Title: EnableAIBuilder
Description: Tier 3 AI Builder classification. Ships FALSE. AI Builder must never become a dependency whose availability could block the app.

Title: EnableTesterPreview
Description: Lets Tester_Flag holders see unreleased screens in the shared environment without altering production defaults.
